title: FSSAI Orders Recall of Everest Cumin Powder Batch After Referral Lab Confirms Pesticide Residues
court: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
case_name: FSSAI enforcement action against Everest Food Products Pvt. Ltd. (cumin powder recall)
citation: Recall order on Batch No. E080668761, issued around 4 October 2026
card_summary: A regulatory sample of Everest's pre-packed cumin powder, drawn from a Goa hotel, tested positive for azoxystrobin and thiamethoxam above the prescribed limits. After Everest contested the result, a Referral Food Laboratory independently confirmed the residues and the unsafe finding. FSSAI directed Everest Food Products to recall the implicated batch, No. E080668761, and keep stock and corrective-action records.
card_tip: A first adverse pesticide-residue result is not final; a food business can and should seek referral testing, but must still execute the recall for the implicated batch once the referral result confirms the finding.
verification_notes: The batch number E080668761, the two pesticides azoxystrobin and thiamethoxam, the Goa sampling location, the referral laboratory confirmation, and the recall direction are consistent across Business Today, Outlook Business and Moneylife reports, all dated around 4-5 October 2026. The original FSSAI order itself was not independently retrieved.
